title: Timed mixed section (22 marks, 20 minutes)
subject: Mathematics
source: Written for mathematics/y11 lesson 99 (Timed mixed section (portal quiz written for this lesson; original questions with mark-scheme answers))
intro: Lesson 99. Own 4MA1-style questions. Read the command word first: 'show that' needs every step; 'exact' means leave surds or π.

questions.q: Show that the solutions of x² - 4x - 3 = 0 are 2 ± √7. [3]
Find the volume of a cone of radius 3 cm and height 8 cm. Give your answer in terms of π. [2]
A rectangle is 8.4 cm by 5.2 cm, each to 1 d.p. Find the upper bound of its perimeter. [2]
Find the interior angle of a regular 18-sided polygon. [2]
Two fair coins are thrown. Find P(two heads). [1]
